Filled points take the tokens Artificial Analysis actually spent on each benchmark task and convert them — using each subscription plan's cross-checked quota and deduction rates — into “how much of the monthly fee this task used up”. Hollow points are the same task at official API list prices (AA basis), including API-only vendors such as DeepSeek, Mistral and NVIDIA. Squares are third-party platforms' own subscriptions (Copilot, JetBrains, Kilo, Nous, Ollama, Chutes, Poe, Volcengine Ark, Qiniu, CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy; second batch: Cursor, Devin, Trae, OpenCode Go, ClinePass, Warp, Qianfan, PPIO, JD Cloud, Synthetic, NanoGPT, Command Code), converted with the same method.

实心点：把 Artificial Analysis 跑每项评测任务实际消耗的 token，按各家订阅 plan 的多源复核额度与扣减率，折算成「用订阅跑这一任务等于花了多少月费」。 空心点：同一任务按官方 API 刊例价的成本（AA 口径），包括 DeepSeek、Mistral、NVIDIA 等只卖 API、没有订阅 plan 的厂商。 方块：第三方平台（Copilot、JetBrains、Kilo、Nous、Ollama、Chutes、Poe、火山方舟、七牛、CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy；第二批：Cursor、Devin、Trae、OpenCode Go、ClinePass、Warp、千帆、PPIO、京东云、Synthetic、NanoGPT、Command Code）自己的订阅，按同一算法折算。

  • Scores and token usage: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 (retrieved 2026-09-24; Claude Sonnet 5.5 added 2026-09-28 and re-fetched 2026-10-08 at the new cache price, GPT-6.1 Sol added 2026-09-29, Gemini 4 Argon added 2026-09-30 (re-checked unchanged after its 10-13 GA), Claude Haiku 5.5 added 2026-10-08, Muse Wonder added 2026-10-12, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 added 2026-10-19, GPT-6.1 Terra added 2026-10-26). Kimi K3.1 Pro added 2026-10-23 (AA tests max only); its Kimi membership deduction rates are untested and assumed to scale with API price from the measured K3 rates. AA splits each model's per-task cost into uncached input, cache reads, cache writes and output; dividing by the API unit prices AA lists gives the tokens used per task.
  • Plan quotas: the multi-source review in 模型订阅等效单价_多源复核.md (low / mid / high quota estimates plus corrected deduction rates). “Midpoint” uses the recommended quota, “Optimistic” the highest estimate and “Conservative” the lowest.
  • Conversion: quota used per task = (uncached input + cache writes) × input rate + cache reads × cache rate + output × output rate; cost per task = quota used × monthly fee ÷ monthly quota. Plans that barely meter cache reads (such as Claude subscriptions) therefore look cheap, because AA tasks hit the cache heavily; plans that charge cache hits at full price (some models on Tencent's general Token Plan) can end up more expensive than the API.
  • Exceptions: Muse Code and Bailian Coding Plan meter by request / fixed tokens, so all token types count the same: cost per task = total tokens per task × that plan's equivalent unit price (CNY per million tokens). Tooltips label these “Total tokens × equivalent unit price”.
  • Data audit (2026-09-24): every plan's price, monthly quota and deduction rates were re-checked against official pages and original community posts by 7 reviewer groups, and each change was accepted only after an adversarial re-check. Key fixes: Claude cache reads do count toward quota — a dedicated study measured about 0.027× the base input price — and all Claude tiers were recomputed from community samples on that basis (weekly multipliers are unpublished; measured roughly Pro : Max 5x : Max 20x = 1 : 4 : 7); OpenAI Business seats equal Plus / Pro 5x per the official limits table; X Premium+ quota lowered; Zhipu and MiMo peak/off-peak midpoints assume usage spread evenly over time; Bailian's four tiers are officially exact; Qwen3.7 cache-hit prices follow implicit caching; Hunyuan adds the cheaper hy3-202608 channel; removed DeepSeek V4 Pro from StepFun Step Plan (only reachable via step-router) and the redirected DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731 from Tencent's general plan. Low-confidence points carry ⚠ notes in the tooltip. Full record: audit/订阅plan数据审计报告.md.
  • Third-party platforms (2026-09-25): of 32 third-party harnesses / resellers checked, the first batch with complete, officially exact or high-confidence deduction rates is included: GitHub Copilot, JetBrains AI, Kilo Pass, Nous Portal, Ollama Cloud, Chutes, Poe, Volcengine Ark Agent Plan, Qiniu enterprise plans and CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy (DS-V4-Flash measured from a bill, other models extrapolated from in-app multipliers — single source); z.ai's international GLM Coding plan is merged into Zhipu. Most are “prepaid at API list price plus a small bonus”, with 1–3× leverage (Chutes ~5×), far below the model makers' own subscriptions. Cache writes use the platform's own write price. A second, medium-confidence batch (every point carries a note) was added the same day: Cursor (two pools — Grok uses the Cursor Models pool reverse-engineered by the community at ~$450/1,200/3,000, the only third-party point near the frontier at 15–22.5×; every other model only gets the Other pool, 2.2–2.5×), Devin Pro/Teams (~$78/month inferred from the community's “$20/week”), Trae (international: $ at API price; China: credits reverse-engineered at 40 = ¥1 list value), OpenCode Go (one shared 100-point pool, per-model caps $15/$30/$60 → 1.5×/3×/6×), ClinePass, Warp, Baidu Qianfan Token Plan, PPIO enterprise, JD Cloud TokenPlan (no cache discount, 64K+ input tier), Synthetic, NanoGPT and Command Code (GOAT/Pro work like OpenCode Go — per-model allowances normalized into one credit pool, frontier models ~2×; Max is a USD pool with a premium-model sub-cap, ~1–1.5×; processing fee not counted). Excluded: Muse “Contributor” pricing and DeepSeek 0424/0420 legacy versions (reference prices not comparable). Factory, Kiro, Qoder, Devin Max and Volcengine Coding Plan remain out (assumptions too strong). Full survey: thirdparty/第三方平台plan与中转单价调查.md.
  • DeepSeek peak / off-peak (2026-09-25): DeepSeek's official V4-Pro-0813 and V4.1-Flash charge peak prices only on weekdays 9–12 and 14–18 Beijing time (35 h/week) and are 50% off at all other times; AA lists the peak price. The official API point is therefore split into “peak” and “off-peak”. Plans that follow a peak/off-peak schedule also get two points: Bailian Token Plan (50% off 22:00–8:00), Ollama (50% off outside weekdays 12–18 UTC) and Qiniu enterprise plans (×0.3 18:00–8:00 and weekends), each with leverage against the official price in the same window. Other plans (Kilo, Ark, Tencent general, CodeBuddy, Poe, Nous…) charge the same all day and have one point; their tooltip gives the leverage against the official off-peak price. With “Cheapest plan only”, peak and off-peak are picked separately; use “DeepSeek peak / off-peak” to switch. V4.1-Flash-1017 (updated 2026-10-19): DeepSeek released V4.1-Flash-1017 on 10-17 at unchanged prices; the official deepseek-flash id and the old aliases now all serve 1017 and the 09-10 version can no longer be called, so the official points now use 1017 (AA has only tested max). Platforms confirmed to offer 1017 now use it and drop the old version: Bailian Token Plan (separate id), Tencent general Token Plan (direct-from-DeepSeek entry renamed), PPIO (entry renamed), Ollama, ClinePass, Nous Portal and NanoGPT. Volcengine Agent Plan, Qianfan Token Plan, Trae, CodeBuddy, Qiniu, SCNet, OpenCode, Command Code and Synthetic show no sign of switching yet and keep the 09-10 version.
  • 2026-10-25 review: StepFun Step Plan now burns 2× Credits for Step 5 Preview on weekdays 9–12 and 14–18 from 10-15 (subscribers who paid before 10-15 are exempt), and its cache-hit price rose from ¥0.35 to ¥0.70 on 10-14 — shown as separate peak / off-peak points. Bailian Token Plan added a limited-time 60%-off night rate (22:00–8:00) for qwen3.8-max, also split into two points (the official API has no time-of-day pricing, so leverage uses the full price). Kimi K3.1 Pro membership burn rates now use a 10-25 community measurement (≈85% of K3, previously assumed 2/3 from API prices). Added Kimi Ultra (¥1,399, quota derived as 2× Max per Kimi). No quota-relevant changes found for Claude, ChatGPT or CodeBuddy/WorkBuddy.
  • 2026-10-26 OpenCode resync: OpenCode Go re-checked against its docs. DeepSeek V4.1 Flash's monthly cap is now $80 (8× the $10 fee; the 4× promo's $60 did not revert — the cap went up instead), metered as V4.1-Flash-1017 (DeepSeek's old model names all point to 1017 since 10-17; inferred). Added Kimi K3.1 Pro, Claude Haiku 5.5, Step 5 Preview ($15 caps), Gemini 4 Argon ($30, launch 50% off until 11-30) and MiMo-V2.6-Flash; GLM-5.1, Kimi K2.6, Grok 4.6, DeepSeek V4 Flash, Qwen3.7 Max and others left the docs and are removed. New plan: Go Plus ($40/mo), same token prices with per-model caps of $60–$240 (e.g. GLM-5.3 $120 = 3×, LongCat-2.0 $240); assumed to share Go's normalized-pool mechanism, no community measurements yet.
  • Model changes (2026-09-27): MiniMax's oldest model, MiniMax-M2.7 (released 2026-03, marked deprecated by AA), is retired: its points on MiniMax Token Plan, Command Code, Ollama Cloud, OpenCode, PPIO and Trae, and its official API point, are removed. The new M3.1-Flash-Preview went live in MiniMax Code on 27 September (billed through Token Plan), but AA has not tested it yet and MiniMax has not published its API or quota deduction prices, so it has no points for now; they will be added once that data is out. Superseded models are also retired: a model AA marks as deprecated is dropped from a plan when the same plan already offers a newer model from the same vendor that scores at least as high as its top effort (0.1 tolerance) at a lower cost per task. This removes Claude Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 / Fable 5 / Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 mini / nano, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.5 Flash and others entirely; GPT-5.6 Sol / Luna, GLM-5.1 / 5.2, Gemini 3.6 Flash and Qwen3.7 Max are dropped only where a replacement exists, and kept on platforms that have not added the newer models yet (Cursor, Devin, Trae, etc.).
  • Official API prices (hollow points): AA's own per-task cost at each vendor's official list price (cache reads and writes at their own prices, using AA's measured cache-hit rates), converted to CNY at the exchange rate below. Includes API-only vendors with no subscription (DeepSeek, Mistral, NVIDIA, Thinking Machines…). For Chinese models AA uses international USD prices; the tooltip also gives the cost at the domestic CNY list price — the two usually differ by 0–15%. Models AA marks as deprecated are hidden by default; models without an AA cost (Gemma 3, Command A+…) are not shown.
  • Assumption: the monthly quota is fully used. With light usage the real cost per task is higher than shown. Free tiers, plans with undisclosed quotas (ChatGPT Go, Google AI Plus, SuperGrok Lite / Plus, Kimi Go, CodeBuddy) and models AA has not tested are not shown.
  • Score source (y-axis, default AA): the vertical axis can be switched from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index to one of three arena.ai human-preference leaderboards (fetched by aa_data/fetch_arena.py): Agent Arena Capabilities (Overall; Net Improvement averaged over five real-session signals — confirmed success, praise vs. complaint, steerability, bash reliability, tool hallucination), Text (Overall, style control on) and Code Arena WebDev (Overall); the latter two are Elo-scale Bradley-Terry ratings. Only the score changes: cost per task is still AA's benchmark tokens per task priced at each plan's equivalent rate or the official API price, so the plan-equivalent mapping is identical across sources. Arena entries are matched to AA models by model and effort (Max / xHigh / High …; entries without an effort map to AA's default variant); combinations Arena does not rank are hidden, and “top effort only” picks the best Arena score per plan. Mapping table: ARENA_NAME in build_plan_chart.py; per-point table: arena_value_points.csv.
  • Quota bonuses (optional, off by default): vendors hand out extra quota that is not in any contract — global resets, reset cards, temporary boosts. Model-specific promotions — free or discounted deduction for one model for a while (e.g. Volcengine's half-price DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, Tencent Token Plan's monthly discounts, Zhipu's free-at-night GLM-5.3-Flash) — count too, but only for that model's point. The “Quota bonuses” switch replays the real event timeline of the last 120 days (2026-06-25 – 10-22) for a user who wants 1.5×, 2× or unlimited times the regular quota per cycle (weekly for plans capped weekly, monthly for monthly pools), and divides the cost per task by the extra work they actually get done. Every subscription source in the chart was surveyed (2026-10-23, web search by sub-agents, not independently cross-checked); sources with no countable event stay at ×1. The replay follows each vendor's mechanics: Codex resets and all reset cards restart the 7-day cycle and wipe what was left, so a user whose demand fits the weekly quota gains nothing; Zhipu's global resets refill without moving the cycle; cards are used the moment the quota next runs out; boosts raise the cap while they last; a discount divides that model's deduction while it lasts, so it only helps a user who would otherwise hit the cap. Promotions already priced into the baseline (e.g. CodeBuddy's 0.03× DeepSeek rate, OpenCode Go's 4× DeepSeek allowance) are not counted twice; promotions for models not in the chart, international-only editions, and free token packs open to non-subscribers are skipped. Resets that compensate a metering error, paid resets and anything that only touches the 5-hour window count as 0. Past frequency does not guarantee future bonuses, so treat this as an optimistic reference. Events and sources: bonus/福利修正说明.md; separate table: plan_value_points_bonus.csv.
  • Coding agent benchmark (optional, off by default): the “Coding agent benchmark” switch recomputes every point's cost per task with the token mix Artificial Analysis actually measured for each coding agent × model × reasoning effort on its Coding Agent benchmark (DeepSWE v1.1 + Terminal-Bench 4.0 + SWE-Atlas-QnA; retrieved 2026-10-08, with Claude Sonnet 5.5 API reference costs corrected to the 10-07 cache price, aa_data/ca_agents.json), and moves the vertical axis to the Coding Agent Index — the score of the whole agent (harness + model + settings), not the bare model. An agent run consumes far more tokens than AA's model-level average task (roughly 1–30M per task, 85–99% cache hits), so costs here are usually higher than in the baseline view; the score can also be higher (Opus 5.5: 57.6 model → 66.0 in Claude Code). Only the combinations AA has measured are shown — usually one harness per model (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok Build, Kimi Code CLI, Muse Code, OpenCode), so “platform” is fixed per model. The measured mix does not split cache writes; the split is taken from the same model's AA cost breakdown (plans meter cache writes at the input rate, so the error is tiny). Devin Fusion runs two models in one task and cannot be priced on a single plan, so it is excluded. Baseline data and all CSVs are unchanged.
  • Exchange rate: 1 USD = CNY.
  • 得分 / token 用量：Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2（2026-09-24 抓取；Claude Sonnet 5.5 于 2026-09-28（10-08 按新缓存价重抓）、GPT-6.1 Sol 于 2026-09-29、Gemini 4 Argon 于 2026-09-30（10-13 正式上线后复核未变）、Claude Haiku 5.5 于 2026-10-08、Muse Wonder 于 2026-10-12、DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 于 2026-10-19、GPT-6.1 Terra 于 2026-10-26 补抓）。Kimi K3.1 Pro 于 2026-10-23 补抓（AA 只测了 max 档）；它在 Kimi 会员里的扣减率没有实测，按 K3 实测扣减卡 × API 价比例推定。每个模型每项任务的成本被拆成未缓存输入、缓存读取、缓存写入、输出四部分，用 AA 标注的 API 单价反推出每任务 token 量。
  • Plan 额度：工作空间 模型订阅等效单价_多源复核.md 的多源复核结果（低 / 中 / 高三档额度 + 扣减率修正）。「中值」用推荐额度，「乐观」用最高额度估计，「保守」用最低额度估计。
  • 折算方法：每任务额度消耗 = (未缓存输入 + 缓存写入) × 输入扣减率 + 缓存读取 × 缓存扣减率 + 输出 × 输出扣减率；每任务成本 = 额度消耗 × 月费 ÷ 月额度。所以缓存不计额度的 plan（如 Claude 订阅）会因为 AA 任务大量命中缓存而更便宜；缓存照原价扣的 plan（如腾讯通用 Token Plan 的部分模型）可能比 API 还贵。
  • 例外：Muse Code 和百炼 Coding Plan 按请求数 / 固定 token 计量，各类 token 同等计数，每任务成本 = 每任务总 token × 该 plan 的等效单价（元 / 百万 token），提示框里标注为「按总 token × 等效单价」。
  • 数据审计（2026-09-24）：各 plan 的月价、月额度、扣减单价已由 7 组审查员回到官方页面与社区原帖逐条复核，每条修改再经反方核验才采纳。主要修正：Claude 订阅的缓存读计入额度，专项调查实测约按 0.027× 基础输入价扣，各档额度据此由社区样本统一重算（周额度倍数官方未公布，实测约 Pro : Max 5x : Max 20x = 1 : 4 : 7）；OpenAI Business 席位按官方限额表等同 Plus / Pro 5x；X Premium+ 额度下调；智谱、MiMo 峰谷统一按时间均匀分布取中值；百炼四档额度高低值作废、Qwen3.7 缓存命中价按隐式缓存；混元加入更便宜的 hy3-202608 通道；删除阶跃 Step Plan 里无法指定的 DeepSeek V4 Pro（只能经 step-router 自动路由）和腾讯通用 plan 中已被重定向的 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 0731。置信度低的点在提示框里带 ⚠ 说明。完整审计记录见工作空间 audit/订阅plan数据审计报告.md。

  • 2026-10-26 OpenCode 重同步：按官方文档重核 OpenCode Go。DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 月上限现为 $80（月费 $10 的 8 倍；9 月 4x 促销的 $60 到期后没有回落，反而上调），按 V4.1-Flash-1017 计（DeepSeek 官方 10-17 起旧名全部指向 1017，推定）；新增 Kimi K3.1 Pro、Claude Haiku 5.5、Step 5 Preview（$15 档）、Gemini 4 Argon（$30，首发 5 折到 11-30）和 MiMo-V2.6-Flash；GLM-5.1、Kimi K2.6、Grok 4.6、DeepSeek V4 Flash、Qwen3.7 Max 等已从文档移除，点一并删除。新增 Go Plus 档（$40/月），token 单价相同、各模型上限 $60–$240（如 GLM-5.3 $120 即 3 倍、LongCat-2.0 $240），按与 Go 相同的归一化单池推定，暂无社区实测。
  • 模型更替（2026-09-27）：淘汰 MiniMax 最老的 MiniMax-M2.7（2026-03 发布，AA 已标记弃用），它在 MiniMax Token Plan、Command Code、Ollama Cloud、OpenCode、PPIO、Trae 里的点和官方 API 点一并删除。新模型 M3.1-Flash-Preview 已于 9 月 27 日上线 MiniMax Code（与 Token Plan 统一计费），但 AA 还没评测、官方也没公布 API 价和额度扣减价，暂时无法出点，数据出来后补上。另外淘汰被取代的旧模型：AA 标记弃用的模型，如果同一 plan 里已有同厂商更新的模型，分数不低于它的最高档（容差 0.1）且每任务更便宜，就删掉它在该 plan 的点。由此整体移出 Claude Opus 5 / Opus 4.8 / Fable 5 / Sonnet 4.6、GPT-5.5、GPT-5.4 mini / nano、GPT-5 mini、Gemini 3.5 Flash 等；GPT-5.6 Sol / Luna、GLM-5.1 / 5.2、Gemini 3.6 Flash、Qwen3.7 Max 只在已有替代的 plan 里删，Cursor、Devin、Trae 等还没上新版的平台保留。
  • 官方 API 价（空心点）：直接取 AA 给出的每任务成本，即各家官方 API 刊例价（缓存读、缓存写按各自单价，AA 已按实测缓存命中率计），按汇率换成人民币。包括只卖 API、没有订阅 plan 的厂商（DeepSeek、Mistral、NVIDIA、Thinking Machines 等）。AA 对国产模型用的是各家国际站美元价；提示框里另附国内人民币刊例价的折算，两者多数相差 0~15%。默认隐藏 AA 标记为已弃用的 API 模型；AA 没给出成本的模型（Gemma 3、Command A+ 等）不在图里。
  • 前提：假设月额度被用满。只是偶尔用的话，实际每任务成本会高于图上数字。免费档、额度未公开的 plan（ChatGPT Go、Google AI Plus、SuperGrok Lite / Plus、Kimi Go、CodeBuddy）以及 AA 没测过的模型不在图里。
  • 纵轴基准（默认 AA）：纵轴可以从 Artificial Analysis 智能指数切换到 arena.ai 的三张真人偏好排行榜（aa_data/fetch_arena.py 抓取）：Agent Arena 能力榜（Overall；Net Improvement，取真实会话里任务确认成功、好评与差评、可纠偏、bash 可靠性、工具幻觉 5 个信号的平均）、文本榜（Overall，开 style control）和 Code Arena WebDev 榜（Overall），后两者是 Elo 刻度的 Bradley-Terry 评分。只换分数：横轴每任务成本仍是 AA 评测每任务 token 量按各 plan 等效单价 / 官方 API 价折算，plan 等效成本映射在各基准下完全相同。Arena 条目按「模型 + 档位」对应到 AA 模型（Max / xHigh / High…；不标档位的对应 AA 默认档），Arena 没收录的组合不显示，「仅最高档」按 Arena 分数在每个 plan 内取最高档。映射表见 build_plan_chart.py 的 ARENA_NAME，逐点对照见 arena_value_points.csv。
  • 额度福利（可选，默认关闭）：厂商会不定期发放合同之外的额度，比如全局重置、重置卡、临时加额。某个模型限时免费或打折扣减（比如火山方舟 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 半价、腾讯 Token Plan 每月的模型折扣、智谱夜间 GLM-5.3-Flash 免费）也算，但只作用于那个模型的点。打开「近 120 天额度福利」后，按近 120 天（2026-06-25 ～ 10-22）真实的事件时间线，模拟一个想用 1.5 倍、2 倍或无限倍常态周期额度（周额度为主的按周，月池按月）的用户实际能多干多少活，再把每任务成本除以这个倍数。图中全部订阅来源都查过（2026-10-23 由子代理联网检索，未做独立交叉核查），没有可计入事件的倍数为 1。模拟按各家机制处理：Codex 的重置和所有重置卡都会清掉当期余量、重开 7 天周期，所以需求没超过周额度的用户拿不到任何福利；智谱的全员重置只清零、不改刷新时间；重置卡在下一次用完额度时使用；临时加额在活动期间抬高上限；扣减优惠在活动期间按折扣少扣该模型的额度，所以也只有会撞到上限的用户才受益。基准已经按促销价算过的（如 CodeBuddy DeepSeek 0.03x、OpenCode Go DeepSeek 4 倍额度）不重复计；图中没有的模型、只在国际版的活动、非订阅用户也能领的免费 token 包都不计。补偿计量异常的重置、付费购买的重置、只作用于 5 小时窗口的调整一律不计。过去的频率不代表以后还会有，只能当偏乐观的参考。事件清单与来源见 bonus/福利修正说明.md，对照表见 plan_value_points_bonus.csv。
  • Coding agent 实测（可选，默认关闭）：打开「Coding agent 实测」开关后，每任务成本改按 Artificial Analysis 编程智能体基准（DeepSWE v1.1 + Terminal-Bench 4.0 + SWE-Atlas-QnA，2026-10-08 抓取，Sonnet 5.5 的 API 对照成本按 10-07 新缓存价修正，aa_data/ca_agents.json）里「智能体 × 模型 × 推理档位」实测的每任务 token 配比折算，纵轴智能分换成 Coding Agent Index——即整个智能体（harness + 模型 + 设置）的得分，不再是裸模型的智能指数。智能体跑一个任务的 token 量远高于 AA 模型级的平均任务（约 1～30M / 任务，缓存命中 85～99%），所以这里的成本通常比基准视图高；得分也可能更高（如 Opus 5.5 裸模型 57.6，Claude Code 里 66.0）。只显示 AA 实测过的组合（通常一个模型只测了一个平台：Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity、Grok Build、Kimi Code CLI、Muse Code、OpenCode），所以「平台」随模型固定。实测数据没有拆分缓存写入，按同模型 AA 成本拆分的比例折算（plan 里缓存写默认按输入价扣，误差很小）。Devin Fusion 一次任务跑两个模型、无法套单一 plan 扣减，未接入。基准数据与全部 CSV 不变。
  • 汇率：1 USD = CNY。
